Discover Your Ikigai

A Conversation About What Makes You Feel Alive

Explore what brings you joy, fulfillment, and a sense of purpose through a personalized conversation. There’s no questionnaire, no time limit, and no right or wrong answers.

To begin: Click below. When ChatGPT opens, press Send to start your guided conversation. You’ll need access to ChatGPT.

Begin Your Exploration

How it works

  1. Discover your ikigai. Explore what matters to you and receive a personalized diagram and analysis.
  2. Explore possibilities. If you wish, explore career directions or ideas for a more fulfilling life beyond work.
  3. Find ways forward. If you wish, identify actual opportunities, activities, projects, and practical next steps.

You can stop after any stage or return to continue later.

Your privacy. Your conversation takes place in your own ChatGPT account, not on this website. If you prefer that your conversations not be used to train OpenAI’s models, open ChatGPT and go to Settings → Data controls → Improve the model for everyone, then turn that setting off. Your chats can still be saved in your ChatGPT history. Learn more about ChatGPT’s data controls.

Sharing feedback with Discover Your Ikigai at discoveryourikigai.app@gmail.com is entirely optional.

Pilot version. Thank you for helping test this experience. You’re welcome to share it privately with a few people you know, but please don’t post the link publicly or redistribute the guide without permission.

We’d love your feedback. Was the experience helpful? Did your results feel accurate and useful? What worked well, what didn’t, or what would you change? You’re also welcome to attach your ikigai diagram so we can see how the experience is working. Please share only what you’re comfortable sharing.
